land.text: the Spanish colony of Jamaica: 'English forces launched an invasion of Jamaica in 1655, capturing the existing Spanish colony'

capitals.name: Kingston
capitals.note: "In 1872, the government passed an act to transfer government offices from Spanish Town to Kingston."

correction.text: the island of Jamaica, 'captured' from Spain in 1655 and formally possessed in 1670; dependencies drawn as vassal land in the ledger

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, Cliopatria has no row before its Jamaica row of 1963 (which is the independent state). The page gives no area; the gazetteer resolves Jamaica to 51 cells, about 12,900 km2. The Cayman Islands, Turks and Caicos, the Bay Islands and British Honduras are dependencies in the infobox, drawn as vassal tint in the ledger.

ledger.note: May 1655: English forces take Jamaica from Spain. 'English forces launched an invasion of Jamaica in 1655, capturing the existing Spanish colony'; infobox 'Established: 10 May 1655'.
1670: Spain cedes Jamaica in the Treaty of Madrid. 'England gained formal possession of Jamaica from Spain in 1670 through the Treaty of Madrid.' No change on the map: the island was held since 1655.

region.text: the Cayman Islands, an attachment of 18 July 1670 in the infobox

ledger.note: 18 July 1670: the Cayman Islands are attached to Jamaica. Infobox 'Attachment ... 18 July 1670' (the page lists four dependencies and four dates in one line; the pairing is by order, the page does not match them).

region.text: British Honduras, an attachment of 1749 in the infobox

ledger.note: 1749: British Honduras is attached to Jamaica. Infobox attachment date '1749' (paired with British Honduras by order of the four names).

region.text: the Bay Islands, attached on 15 June 1852 according to the infobox

ledger.note: 15 June 1852: the Bay Islands are attached to Jamaica. Infobox 'Attachment ... 15 June 1852' (pairing by order).

region.text: the Bay Islands, detached on 14 July 1860

ledger.note: 14 July 1860: the Bay Islands are detached. Infobox 'Detachment ... 14 July 1860' (pairing by order).
1872: the capital moves from Spanish Town to Kingston. 'In 1872, the government passed an act to transfer government offices from Spanish Town to Kingston.'

region.text: the Turks and Caicos Islands, attached on 4 April 1873

ledger.note: 4 April 1873: the Turks and Caicos Islands are attached to Jamaica. Infobox 'Attachment ... 4 April 1873' (pairing by order).
2 October 1884: British Honduras is detached from Jamaica. Infobox 'Detachment ... 2 October 1884' (pairing by order).

region.text: the Cayman Islands, detached on 4 July 1959

ledger.note: 4 July 1959: the Cayman Islands and the Turks and Caicos Islands cease to be dependencies. Infobox 'Detachment ... 4 July 1959' twice.

region.text: the Turks and Caicos Islands, detached on 4 July 1959

ledger.note: 4 July 1959: the Turks and Caicos Islands are detached from Jamaica (infobox 'Detachment ... 4 July 1959' twice).
6 August 1962: Jamaica becomes independent. Infobox 'Independence: 6 August 1962'.

wars.name: Maroon wars of Jamaica
wars.outcome: No territorial result on the map: peace agreements in 1739 and 1740 (Windward Maroons, Blue Mountains) and the Trelawny Maroons accepted the stalemate in December 1795.
wars.note: The page lists the treaties by year only; the Maroon enclaves are not drawn.

certainty.note: An island: the coast is the frontier; the dependencies (Cayman, Turks and Caicos, Bay Islands, British Honduras) are approximate in the sense of the infobox pairing.

sources.title: Colony of Jamaica
sources.note: Infobox (10 May 1655, 6 August 1962, capitals, the four dependencies with dates), 1670 Treaty of Madrid, Maroon treaties 1739-1740, 1866 crown colony, 1958 Federation.

notes:
Cliopatria has no row for colonial Jamaica (its Jamaica row is 1963-2024). One page opened (budget 1-2): the infobox lists four dependencies and four attachment and five detachment dates in one jumbled line; they are paired by order (Bay Islands 1852-1860, British Honduras 1749-1884, Cayman Islands 1670-1959, Turks and Caicos 1873-1959), a pairing the page does not state, hence confidence 2. The British Honduras link is also in the british-honduras dossier (written here).
The Federation of the West Indies (1958-1962) is mentioned by the page ('formed in 1958') without an end date on the part fetched; Jamaica's entry into and exit from it are not recorded here (see the west-indies-federation dossier if one is written in this batch).
Counterpart names 'Cayman Islands', 'Turks and Caicos Islands' and 'Bay Islands' are names, not slugs: those dependencies have no dossiers.
